parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(signals)), '[]'::json) AS signals FROM (SELECT dedupe_key, title, source, intent, urgency, priority, tool_mentioned, pain_point, elvan_angle, draft_reply, url, score, base_score, boosted_score, occurred_at FROM public.signal_events WHERE source_system = 'n8n' AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY score DESC, occurred_at DESC LIMIT 500) signals;
